2609.07893.title: Explainable Temporal Attention-based Defect Detection For Fillet Joints in Real-Time Gas Metal Arc Welding Based on Multi-modal Data
2609.07893.paper_summary: Deep learning is an efficient technique to monitor the real time welding process, reducing post-welding repairs and production delays. This paper leverages the monitoring capability by proposing a multi modal temporal attention based deep learning defect detection model for internal defects that are challenging to detect, including porosity, lack of penetration and fusion, undercut, and cold lap during Gas Metal Arc Welding in fillet joints. The model is trained on collected welding images and sound data from an industrial collaborative welding robot. The results show that the attention module can improve the F1 Score to 0.99. We use explainable Artificial Intelligence to interpret the proposed models behavior and dataset distribution, determining potential important areas in image and sound spectrograms and preferred modality to detect each defect. This improves trust and reliability in Artificial Intelligence driven welding inspection.
2609.07893.paper_summary_zh: 深度學習是一種有效的技術，用於監控實時焊接過程，減少焊後修理和生產延遲。這篇論文利用監控能力，提出了一種基於多模態時間注意力的深度學習缺陷檢測模型，用於檢測內部缺陷，這些缺陷包括孔洞、滲透不足和熔合、切口以及在角焊接中的冷搭接，這些缺陷都很難檢測。該模型在從工業協作焊接機器人收集的焊接圖像和聲音數據上進行訓練。結果顯示，注意力模塊可以將F1分數提高到0.99。我們使用可解釋的人工智慧來解釋所提出模型的行為和數據集分佈，確定圖像和聲音聲譜中潛在的重要區域以及檢測每個缺陷的首選模態。這提高了對人工智慧驅動的焊接檢查的信任和可靠性。
